description: This file contains a unit test class 'HolidayServiceTest' for the 'HolidayService' component within the 'OrangeHRM' Human Resource Management system. It tests holiday search functionalities, CRUD operations, and ensures correct handling of recurring and non-recurring holidays, with a focus on date filtering, pagination, and uniqueness.

classes.name: HolidayServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the HolidayService functionalities, including CRUD operations, holiday searches with different filters, and validation of holiday data handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures, configures mock services, and prepares the testing environment before each test.

methods.name: testGetSetHolidayDao
methods.description: Tests that the HolidayService correctly returns an instance of HolidayDao.

methods.name: testSaveHoliday
methods.description: Verifies that saving a Holiday object through the service invokes the DAO's saveHoliday method and returns the saved Holiday.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysNoneRecurring
methods.description: Tests searching for non-recurring holidays within a date range, ensuring correct filtering.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysRecurringCurrentYear
methods.description: Tests the search of recurring holidays for the current year, validating correct recurring holiday retrieval.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysRecurringOtherYear
methods.description: Tests for recurring holidays in years other than the current, ensuring correct filtering based on recurrence and date.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysMultiYear
methods.description: Validates searching across multiple years, ensuring holidays are correctly filtered within the date range, including past and future dates.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysPartYear
methods.description: Tests filtering holidays that occur partially within the specified date range, especially for recurring holidays with different start dates.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysCheckUniqueness
methods.description: Ensures that the list of holidays returned does not contain duplicates and respects the specified limit and offset for pagination.

methods.name: compareHolidays
methods.description: Utility function to compare two lists of Holiday objects, asserting all attributes match.

methods.name: compareHoliday
methods.description: Utility function to compare two individual Holiday objects.
